privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is important to me.

responsible.title: Responsible Party
responsible.text: Responsible for data processing on this website is:

collection.title: Data Collection and Processing
collection.text: When you visit this website, the server automatically stores log data: IP address, time, page requested, referrer URL, browser and operating system. It is used for secure operation and simple visitor statistics without tracking services and is deleted after 14 days.

contact_form.title: Contact Form
contact_form.text: When you send me a message via the contact form, your information (name, email, message) is stored to process your inquiry.

upload.title: 3D File Upload
upload.text: Uploaded 3D files are used for quote preparation and deleted after project completion unless otherwise agreed.

software.title: Software purchase and licence
software.text: When you buy software (MacYaesu, Kamera-Import), payment is processed by PayPal (Europe) S.à r.l. et Cie, S.C.A., Luxembourg; PayPal's privacy policy also applies. PayPal provides me with your name, email address, amount and payment status, plus the licence email you entered. I use this data to generate and deliver the licence key and for support. It is kept as long as statutory retention rules for business records require. The apps themselves transmit no usage data; the licence is checked offline on your Mac.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to information, correction, deletion, and restriction of processing of your data. Contact me via email for this.
